drafts.passage: On the Tamsin-News test split, Verisum reduced the hallucination rate from 15.1% (Corran-Sum) to 8.7%, a 42.4% relative reduction. This reduction is larger than the 26.5% relative reduction achieved by our re-implementation of salience pre-filtering (from 15.1% to 11.0%), and also exceeds the roughly 30% reduction reported for salience pre-filtering by Varga & Sandoval (2021). Verisum also achieved the highest ROUGE-L (38.9) among the compared systems, indicating that the additional entity-grounding loss did not sacrifice summary quality.
